name: fbdl6-counterexample-v1
statement: FBDL(6) is false for real point sets: these 16 integer points in general position contain no convex hexagon and admit no full-range band stack (bands j=0..4 with cup <= j+1 and cap <= 5-j, chain convention of harness.research.chains).
band_shape_note: On 16 points the cups-caps bound forces |B_j| = C(4,j): a point, a 4-cap set, a 6-set with no 4-cup and no 4-cap, a 4-cup set, a point. The falsifier checks both the general library search (no size assumption) and this shape by brute force.
